name: Clementine Neonica
source:
VANISHMENT THIS WORLD! If you feel weird about her behaviour, it's common with Clementine Neonica. She is a chūnibyō, constantly living out her fantasies and exhibiting strange behaviors as a result. She's very open about them, and she claims that she has "Fast Movement" and "Hard Light Construct", and a crystal which "traps light in order to use her powers at night". Though she does her best to commit to her fantasies, she can break character, such as when she feels embarrassed or flustered.

[From [url=https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
